title: 3-on-1 Keep-Away
description: Three passers keep the ball away from one defender inside a small area, building quick, accurate passing, spacing and communication under pressure.

content.objective: Complete accurate passes under defensive pressure, moving without the ball to create passing angles and using fakes to open the lane.
content.setup: Mark a square about five metres wide with four cones. Three passers stand inside it in a triangle and one defender stands in the middle. Additional groups work in other squares.
instructions: The passers pass the ball to each other while the defender tries to deflect or intercept it.
Passers may not dribble and must keep one foot on the ground (pivot) when holding the ball.
When the defender touches the ball or the ball leaves the square, the passer who made the pass becomes the defender.
Count how many consecutive passes the passers can make before losing the ball.
Play rounds of 90 seconds, then rotate the defender.
coachingPoints: Move to open space and show a target hand for the pass.
Use ball fakes and pivots to open the passing lane.
Pass away from the defender's hands and step into the pass.
Communicate: call for the ball and name the passer.
commonMistakes: Standing still in a line so the defender covers everyone.
Telegraphing the pass with the eyes.
Throwing lazy passes across the defender's reach.
content.safety: Keep the squares apart to avoid collisions between groups and pick up loose balls quickly.
progressions: Make it 4-on-2 and require five passes before a shot on the basket.
regressions: Enlarge the square or allow the passers to dribble once.
variations: Award a point to the passers for every ten consecutive passes.
